# Hidden worker, fired from the options (var oe_j7_job): every change of ruler, prison, heir and co-emperor stays out of
# the option previews. Jobs: 20 the street roll, 21 usurpation, 22 street won, 23 street lost, 30 the restoration roll,
# 31 restored, 32 restoration failed, 33 the new emperor accepted, 34 restored by the sultan, 41 heir and co-emperor (job 39
# runs from the monthly round); phase 2: 61 the reconciliation roll (62 the claimant comes back, 63 would not).
oe_j7.90 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_j7.90.t
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 20 } oe_j7_job_20 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 21 } oe_j7_job_21 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 22 } oe_j7_job_22 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 23 } oe_j7_job_23 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 30 } oe_j7_job_30 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 31 } oe_j7_job_31 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 32 } oe_j7_job_32 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 33 } oe_j7_job_33 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 34 } oe_j7_job_34 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 41 } oe_j7_job_41 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_job ?= 61 } oe_j7_job_61 = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_job } remove_variable = oe_j7_job }
    }
}
